body:
Note on vesting which also relates to adam's point - if you already have a job, or are paid elsewhere then it is easier to play the long game and take EDG that is mostly locked. 

In some ways this approach punishes those solely focused on edgeware... really, the problem is the same as always - creating demand for EDG and enabling liquidity. 

The above is more fire fighting - but without a focus on the other side of things.

I would love to see more focus on this, and less on how to optimise an ever smaller pie.
You're correct, optimising the pie isn't the only solution we need. It's one of the many things which will create a major impact together collectively.

For SCU NOV Incentives 

10% Unlocked 
90% Vested until 1/5/2025 ( at least 1 year)
I like to eat food. Could we do 50% 50% I think that is reasonable.
